anzsic_codes.name: Other Auxiliary Finance and Investment Services

merger_description:
Novotech Aus BidCo Pty Ltd, a subsidiary of Novotech SG Holdings Pty Ltd (Novotech) proposes to acquire 100% of the shares in Agilex Biolabs Pty Ltd (Agilex).

Novotech is a full-service clinical research organisation (CRO) and science advisory company, operating worldwide. In Australia, Novotech provides CRO services offering clinical trial design and management across principally Phases I to III of clinical trial development. Novotech does not have any laboratories in Australia and does not provide any bioanalytical laboratory services from Australia. It operates laboratories in Shanghai and Taipei from which it supplies some offshore laboratory services for clinical trials in Australia. Novotech also has a sample collection and storage facility in North Carolina (USA).

Novotech’s controlling shareholders are private investment funds affiliated with TPG Inc (TPG). TPG is a global alternative asset management firm headquartered in the United States with $306 billion of assets under management as at 31 March 2026.

Agilex is an Australian specialist bioanalytical services provider supporting non-clinical and clinical drug development programmes across Phases I to III, with Phase I being a core focus. Agilex's services are focused on bioanalysis and specialised sample processing. Agilex has laboratories in Adelaide and Brisbane, with a Sydney facility in development.

determination_table_content.details:
When making a determination in Phase 1, the Australian Competition
and Consumer Commission (ACCC) undertakes a competition
assessment and considers whether it is appropriate for an
acquisition to be approved or subject to further assessment in
Phase 2 in accordance with section 51ABZJ of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act). In doing so, the ACCC must have
regard to the object of the Act and all relevant matters, including the
interests of consumers.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notified acquisitions, see the ACCC’s merger assessment guidelines
and interim merger process guidelines.
In conducting its competition assessment, the ACCC has considered
the information and documents that were submitted with the
notification form, information from third parties and publicly
available information.
The ACCC has determined that the Acquisition may be put into
effect as it considers that the Acquisition would be unlikely to have
the effect of substantially lessening competition in any market. In
reaching its decision, and based on the material before it, the ACCC
makes the following findings.
• There is no material horizontal overlap between Novotech and
Agilex in the supply of either bioanalytical laboratory services or
clinical research organisation services in Australia. While
Novotech supplies limited offshore bioanalytical services to
sponsors conducting clinical trials in Australia, other suppliers
with laboratories in Australia appear to compete more closely
with Agilex. Agilex does not supply clinical research organisation
services.
• The merged firm would be unlikely to have the ability and
incentive to foreclose rival clinical research organisations
because it would continue to face competition from alternative
suppliers of bioanalytical laboratory services in Australia.
• Some third parties noted that the Acquisition would remove the
independence of Agilex and raised concerns that Novotech
could access and misuse competitively significant information
provided to Agilex by rival clinical research organisations. The
ACCC found that rival clinical research organisations and
sponsors would have the ability to procure bioanalytical
laboratory services from alternative laboratory service providers.
